recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key portrait of a male figure wearing a dark fedora, with the brim casting a deep shadow over one eye. The composition uses a tight crop focusing on the face and a hand adjusting the hat, featuring a dual-layered typographic treatment at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Shadow from hat brim bisecting the face diagonally
Hand position creating a frame for the visible eye
Contrast between warm skin tones and deep black negative space
Juxtaposition of heavy industrial stencil type and elegant script
coreInvariants: Text positioned in the lower third
Distressed texture on primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, subject occupies 80% of the frame, slightly off-center to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The visible eye peering from under the hat brim.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the hand on the left, across the brim to the eye, down the nose to the large text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black background surrounding the head and filling the upper left corner.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low overall saturation, except for the warm skin and copper accent.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses wide, square-proportioned caps with stencil-like gaps
Secondary text uses a fluid, slanted cursive with high stroke contrast
Primary text features a heavy 'grunge' or 'weathered' internal texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal bars in letters like 'A' or 'E' are often detached or replaced with gaps
Terminals on script letters are elongated and tapered
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between industrial/rugged and elegant/refined styles.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider implied by text alignment

candidateDirections.reason: Square proportions and wide stance match the primary text skeleton.
Formal, high-contrast calligraphic style for the subtitle.
Provides the necessary industrial/military gap aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A moody, low-key portrait of a man in a black fedora, one eye hidden by the brim, hand touching the hat. Use warm directional lighting against a black background. High detail on skin texture and hat felt.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, wide stencil-style white text at the bottom with a distressed texture. Above it, to the right, add a smaller elegant script in copper-orange.

verificationChecks: Is the hat brim shadow cutting across the face?
Is the large text textured and stenciled?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the grunge texture on text
Angle of the hat brim shadow
Saturation of the copper accent color
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Exact facial features of the individual
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the stencil gaps in the text are clean and intentional.
Check that the script text is legible against the subject's clothing.
Verify the shadow doesn't completely obscure both eyes.
Confirm the color palette remains restricted to black, beige, white, and copper.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast 'mystery' portrait with a dual-font typographic lockup featuring one weathered industrial face and one refined script face.
